correctness.rationale: Every nonzero rank-one square-zero matrix is uniquely a scaled outer product with annihilating functional, giving orbit size H. For rank-one targets, the row/image common-line dichotomy and inclusion-exclusion give the exact fiber. For rank-two targets, each ordered decomposition is uniquely an ordered pair of complementary image lines exchanged by T=C restricted to im(C); its trace-zero rank 0/1/invertible eigenline cases yield exactly q(q+1), 2q, or q+1-e(T). The odd-characteristic quadratic character and even-characteristic scalar/Jordan alternatives exhaust invertible cases. All eight finite configurations are fully enumerated by attached executable; no experiment is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural pointwise orbital-convolution invariant, equivalent to the exact distribution of the sum of two uniformly sampled minimal nilpotent matrices in every matrix size over every finite field. It identifies meaningful split/nonsplit spectral multiplicities and a characteristic-two scalar obstruction invisible to qualitative decomposition criteria. The invariant is intrinsic, not an arbitrary slice or trivial renaming.
